demos.name: SingleRowSelectionGrid
demos.description: Single row selection comes enabled by default for the MIT Data Grid component.

demos.name: MultipleRowSelectionGrid
demos.description: Unselect one of the selected rows by holding the Ctrl (Cmd on MacOS) key and clicking on the selected row.

demos.name: DisableClickSelectionGrid
demos.description: You might have interactive content in the cells and need to disable the selection of the row on click.

demos.name: DisableRowSelection
demos.description: In the demo below only rows with quantity above 50,000 can be selected:

demos.name: KeepNonExistentRowsSelected
demos.description: By default, when the rows are filtered the selection is cleared from the rows that don't meet the filter criteria.

demos.name: ControlledSelectionGrid
demos.description: - type: 'include': Only the rows with IDs in the ids set are selected - type: 'exclude': All rows are selected except those with IDs in the ids set

demos.name: CheckboxSelectionGrid
demos.description: To activate checkbox selection set checkboxSelection={true}.

demos.name: CheckboxSelectionCustom
demos.description: In the following demo, the checkbox column has been moved to the right and its width has been increased to 100px.

demos.name: CheckboxSelectionVisibleOnlyGrid
demos.description: By default, when you click the "Select All" checkbox, all rows in the Data Grid are selected.

demos.name: ControlledSelectionServerPaginationGrid
demos.description: By using this approach, clicking in the Select All checkbox may still leave some rows selected.

demos.name: RowSelectionApiNoSnap
demos.description: This API should only be used as a last resort when the Data Grid's built-in props aren't sufficient for your specific use case.
